# CodeRabbit findings for PAN-4957 (PR #5040)

but each one gets an answer, either a fix or a reply with your reason.

- Thread 4470879479 · .overdeck/context/codebase/architecture.md:25 [Minor]: Escape the pipes in the integrations table row.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5040#discussion_r4470879479

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5040/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-4957`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5040 has already merged when you read this, nothing more lands on it: open a follow-up issue
   for the findings you agree with instead of pushing.
